caption: The release pipeline: versionCode rises to 8, the build is compiled and shrunk, signed with the release key, tested, then deployed. Testing follows signing, so the bytes tested are the bytes shipped.

spec.title: Release APK pipeline
spec.aria: The release pipeline sets a higher version code, builds and shrinks the APK, signs it with the release keystore, tests the signed APK, then deploys it to a store or by direct install.
